Here is my (admittedly shitty) advice:

One thing that I was told by one of my former bosses is "work to live, don't live to work". What that means to me is that you need to be able to disconnect from work and do what you love, whatever that is. I personally spent a long time in a job that was killing me mentally and physically, and I'm real damn glad that I don't work there anymore. I'm currently making less money doing what amounts to playing with RAID arrays before I go home and play around with RAID arrays.

My point is, if you can find a job that you can tolerate that leaves you time for your hobbies, then go for it. If you can find a job that IS one of your hobbies, then go for it.
